"""Generate SMT-LIB obligations whose model is extracted from arith.py.

Unlike obligations.txt — which hardcodes the mathematical model and is
therefore blind to changes in the module — this script parses arith.py
with Python's `ast` and translates each function's return expression
into an SMT-LIB `define-fun`. The generated file is bound to the module:
any mutation of arith.py's arithmetic changes the model Z3 verifies, so
a violation appears as `sat` on the affected laws.

Usage:
    python gen_obligations.py > obligations.gen.smt2
    /tmp/pylibs/bin/z3 -smt2 -file:obligations.gen.smt2

Exits non-zero if arith.py does not contain a translatable `add` and
`multiply` (only `+`/`*` over the function's parameters is supported).
"""

import ast
import sys

OP_MAP = {ast.Add: "+", ast.Sub: "-", ast.Mult: "*"}
FUNC_NAMES = ("add", "multiply")

LAWS = [
    ("Obligation 1 — add is commutative",
     "(forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (add a b) (add b a)))"),
    ("Obligation 2 — add is associative",
     "(forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int)) "
     "(= (add (add a b) c) (add a (add b c))))"),
    ("Obligation 3 — multiply is commutative",
     "(forall ((a Int) (b Int)) (= (multiply a b) (multiply b a)))"),
    ("Obligation 4 — multiply is associative",
     "(forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int)) "
     "(= (multiply (multiply a b) c) (multiply a (multiply b c))))"),
    ("Obligation 5 — multiply distributes over add",
     "(forall ((a Int) (b Int) (c Int)) "
     "(= (multiply a (add b c)) (add (multiply a b) (multiply a c))))"),
]


def to_smt(node):
    if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and type(node.op) in OP_MAP:
        return f"({OP_MAP[type(node.op)]} {to_smt(node.left)} {to_smt(node.right)})"
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        return node.id
    raise ValueError(f"unsupported expression in module: {ast.dump(node)}")


def extract_funcs(path):
    tree = ast.parse(open(path).read())
    funcs = {}
    for item in tree.body:
        if isinstance(item, ast.FunctionDef) and item.name in FUNC_NAMES:
            args = [a.arg for a in item.args.args]
            ret = next(
                n for n in ast.walk(item) if isinstance(n, ast.Return)
            ).value
            funcs[item.name] = (args, to_smt(ret))
    missing = set(FUNC_NAMES) - set(funcs)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"missing functions in {path}: {sorted(missing)}")
    return funcs


def main():
    path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "arith.py"
    funcs = extract_funcs(path)

    print("; GENERATED from arith.py by gen_obligations.py — do not edit by hand.")
    print("; Model is extracted from the module, so Z3 results track the code.")
    for name, (args, body) in funcs.items():
        arg_list = " ".join(f"({a} Int)" for a in args)
        print(f"(define-fun {name} ({arg_list}) Int {body})")
    print()
    for title, law in LAWS:
        print(f"; {title}  (expected: unsat = proved, sat = violated)")
        print("(assert")
        print("  (not")
        print(f"    {law}))")
        print("(check-sat)")
        print("(push)")
        print("(pop)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except (SyntaxError, ValueError, StopIteration) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
